title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: piling
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: CFA piles for the grandstands and roof columns
swms.task: Drill and install CFA piles for the grandstands and roof support columns with the CFA piling rig, pumping concrete through the auger and placing the reinforcement cages with the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; the crane company's dogman slings and releases loads, and our licensed dogman receives and lands them with tag lines.
facts.rigExclusionZone: Each rig has a fenced and signed exclusion zone of 20 m radius (at least the mast height plus 5 m). Only the rig crew enters, with the operator's agreement, controlled by the piling supervisor.
facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the geotechnical engineer for the CFA rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to the rig operator before the rig goes on it.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts
Lift and plunge cages into the fresh CFA pile
